headline: Return with 35–40 minutes easy
summary: Recovery has improved after rest. Keep today's run conversational and short because sleep was only 5h 45m.

recommendation.title: 35–40 minutes easy
details: Run conversationally at RPE 2–3 on a flat or gently rolling route; do not chase pace.
Keep it easy after Saturday’s 22 km long run.
recommendation.alternative: Walk gently for 20–30 minutes or rest if tired, sore or unwell.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain that changes gait, dizziness or illness; follow medical advice.
